sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球知名的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内合作创新，寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这都是该大学旨在提升所有生物生活质量的使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 了解更多信息请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Chicago is next.
sentences.zh: 接下来是芝加哥。

sentences.en: If you want to stand out as a skyscraper in Chicago, you've got your work cut out for you.
sentences.zh: 如果你想在芝加哥的摩天大楼中脱颖而出，那你可得面临不小的挑战。

sentences.en: I've stood at this corner a zillion billion times and never looked up at this building.
sentences.zh: 我在这个街角站过无数次，却从未抬头看过这座建筑。

sentences.en: There's the Hancock building, there's the Sears Tower.
sentences.zh: 那里有汉考克大厦，那里有西尔斯大厦。

sentences.en: Yeah, you're supposed to call it the Willis Tower now.
sentences.zh: 对，你现在应该叫它威利斯大厦了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm not going to call it this.
sentences.zh: 行吧，我才不这么叫呢。

sentences.en: And then there's my friend Dan Weissman's new favorite building in the South Loop.
sentences.zh: 然后就是我的朋友丹·韦斯曼在南环区发现的新最爱建筑。

sentences.en: A couple days ago, I was at the Cultural Center and there's like a map of Chicago architectural landmarks.
sentences.zh: 几天前，我在文化中心，那里有一张芝加哥建筑地标的地图。

sentences.en: I mean, it's got zillions of buildings on it.
sentences.zh: 我是说，上面有无数的建筑。

sentences.en: Houses, everything.
sentences.zh: 住宅，各种各样的。

sentences.en: And this building's not on it.
sentences.zh: 而这座建筑却不在上面。

sentences.en: Even if a building is designed by a prominent architect.
sentences.zh: 即使这座建筑是由杰出建筑师设计的。

sentences.en: It's by this guy, Harry Weiss, who made the DC Metro.
sentences.zh: 它是哈里·韦斯这位设计了华盛顿地铁的人设计的。

sentences.en: He's a big deal.
sentences.zh: 他是个大人物。

sentences.en: And even if that building has only three sides, it's like a triangle from above.
sentences.zh: 而且即使这座建筑只有三面，从上方看像个三角形。

sentences.en: Like a grilled cheese sandwich cut in half, diagonally.
sentences.zh: 就像一个切成两半的对角线烤奶酪三明治。

sentences.en: And has these irregularly placed long vertical window slits.
sentences.zh: 并且有着这种不规则排列的长条形垂直窗缝。

sentences.en: Just like a punch card or a Scantron card.
sentences.zh: 就像打孔卡或扫描答题卡一样。

sentences.en: It's still hard to stand out as a skyscraper in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 要在芝加哥作为一座摩天大楼脱颖而出依然很难。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible.
I remember the first time I noticed it.
sentences.zh: 我记得我第一次注意到它的时候。

sentences.en: I was like, what is that building?
sentences.zh: 我在想，那是什么建筑？

sentences.en: And someone there was like, oh, it's a jail.
sentences.zh: 然后旁边有人说，哦，那是座监狱。

sentences.en: My name is Jack Hartray.
sentences.zh: 我叫杰克·哈特雷。

sentences.en: I was the project manager on the Campbell Correctional Center.
sentences.zh: 我是坎贝尔惩教中心的项目经理。

sentences.en: Which most people know as the Metropolitan Correctional Center, or MCC.
sentences.zh: 大多数人知道它是联邦惩教中心，也就是 MCC。

sentences.en: It's a federal detention facility.
sentences.zh: 这是一个联邦拘留设施。

sentences.en: It's where you stay when you're waiting to go up on trial in the federal courthouse, which is like two blocks away.
sentences.zh: 当你等待在联邦法院受审时，就会待在这里，法院就在大概两个街区外。

sentences.en: When it was built, nobody much liked the idea of a federal jail downtown.
sentences.zh: 它建造时，没多少人喜欢在市中心建一座联邦监狱的主意。

sentences.en: The mayor didn't want this building built in the loop.
sentences.zh: 市长不想在环区建造这座建筑。

sentences.en: It's right across the street from a club called the Union League Club, which is one of the kind of fancy elite clubs in the city.
sentences.zh: 它正对面是一个叫联盟联盟俱乐部的俱乐部，这是市内某种高档精英俱乐部之一。

sentences.en: And people were like, we don't want prisoners, you know, mooning us from the windows of the jail.
sentences.zh: 人们觉得，我们可不希望囚犯们在监狱窗户边朝我们露出屁股。

sentences.en: And it doesn't seem like it's going to be really good for property values.
sentences.zh: 而且这似乎对房地产价值没什么好处。

sentences.en: So there was a lawsuit, actually.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上还打了一场官司。

sentences.en: But to their legal misfortune, they had to bring the suit in federal court.
sentences.zh: 但倒霉的是，他们不得不把官司打到联邦法院去。

sentences.en: So the only people who were going to hear the suit were also the only people in town who wanted the thing built.
sentences.zh: 所以审理此案的人，恰好也是城里唯一想建这东西的人。

sentences.en: They were federal judges.
sentences.zh: 他们是联邦法官。

sentences.en: And I think it took them about, you know, 12 minutes to get the thing kicked out of the court.
sentences.zh: 我想他们大概花了12分钟就把这案子给驳回了。

sentences.en: It was impossible to get a judge that wasn't in favor of building the building.
sentences.zh: 根本不可能找到一个不支持建造这座建筑的法官。

sentences.en: The architects and Harry Wiese's group were tickled by the prospect as well.
sentences.zh: 建筑师和哈里·韦斯的团队对这个前景也感到兴致盎然。

sentences.en: Jack Hartray, who worked on the building, said,
sentences.zh: 曾参与该建筑工作的杰克·哈特雷说：

sentences.en: I think everybody in the office figured that you had a certain number of unindicted criminals in the city,
sentences.zh: 我想办公室里的每个人都认为，城里总归有一定数量未被起诉的罪犯，

sentences.en: and then you had some that had gotten caught.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一些是被抓到的。

sentences.en: And the MCC was just for the people who happened to have gotten caught.
sentences.zh: 而MCC就是专门为那些恰好被抓到的人准备的。

sentences.en: And because the architects took it seriously that the inmates were innocent until proven guilty, they thought,
sentences.zh: 因为建筑师们认真对待了“嫌疑人在被证明有罪之前是无辜的”这一理念，他们想：

sentences.en: Let's make this as nice as we can.
sentences.zh: 让我们把它建得尽可能舒适。

sentences.en: You know, somebody already looked at this problem.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，以前已经有人研究过这个问题了。

sentences.en: How do you make a really small space cozy?
sentences.zh: 怎样把一个极小的空间变得温馨？

sentences.en: Harry sort of viewed this from the standpoint of the accommodations on sailboats.
sentences.zh: 哈里有点像是从帆船舱内设施的角度来看待这个问题。

sentences.en: The furniture was all built in, so you could really do pretty nice furniture.
sentences.zh: 家具全都是嵌入式的，所以你可以做得相当漂亮。

sentences.en: Built-in hardwood furniture has these really clean lines.
sentences.zh: 嵌入式硬木家具线条非常简洁。

sentences.en: The bed, there's a desk.
sentences.zh: 床，还有书桌。

sentences.en: I've seen this picture.
sentences.zh: 我见过这张照片。

sentences.en: It's really, you know, it's nice.
sentences.zh: 真的很不错，你知道的。

sentences.en: We built rooms to scale in our office.
sentences.zh: 我们在办公室里按比例搭建了房间模型。

sentences.en: And my children used to come down and take naps, and they loved the interior space.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们过去常常过来小睡，他们非常喜欢内部空间。

sentences.en: It was, you know, kind of intimate and pleasant.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那种空间感觉很亲切也很舒适。

sentences.en: It was cozy.
sentences.zh: 非常温馨。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And those narrow-slit windows I mentioned earlier, those are floor-to-ceiling windows to let in as much light as possible.
sentences.zh: 而我刚才提到的那些狭窄的长条窗，其实是落地窗，为了尽可能引入更多的光线。

sentences.en: But they're also built just narrow enough at five inches so that they were within the federal guidelines of the time to not need bars.
sentences.zh: 但它们的宽度也恰好控制在五英寸的狭窄范围内，这样就符合当时的联邦标准，不需要装铁栏杆。

sentences.en: Sounds really nice.
sentences.zh: 听起来真不错。

sentences.en: Oh, it is nice.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实很不错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: No, it is.
sentences.zh: 不，真的很好。

sentences.en: It's not a bad place to stay.
sentences.zh: 这不是个待着很糟糕的地方。

sentences.en: I saw an interview with Harry Weiss where he said that what he had in mind was like a hotel.
sentences.zh: 我看到过一个对哈里·韦斯的采访，他说他当时构想的就像一家酒店。

sentences.en: Well, we were doing a hotel at the same time, and this was better than the hotel, you know, as far as the built-in furniture and all of that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们当时同时还在设计一家酒店，就嵌入式家具和其他一切而言，这个甚至比那家酒店还要好。

sentences.en: Show me the hotel.
sentences.zh: 让我看看那家酒店吧。

sentences.en: Dan has a reporter's tenacity like you wouldn't believe,
sentences.zh: 丹有着超乎想象的记者般的不屈不挠精神，

sentences.en: but he just couldn't get the warden to let him in to the MCC to see if all these beautiful Harry Weiss interiors and designs were still intact.
sentences.zh: 但他就是无法让典狱长让他进入MCC，去看看所有这些美丽的哈里·韦斯室内设计是否完好无损。

sentences.en: So I called around thinking, like, well, who gets inside these places?
sentences.zh: 所以我四处打电话，心想，好吧，到底是什么人能进到这些地方里面去呢？

sentences.en: And I ended up talking to a guy named Phil Kerrigan.
sentences.zh: 我最后和一个叫菲尔·克里根的人聊了聊。

sentences.en: If you went into the facility and talked to a random bunch of detainees, they would be aghast at that description or would maybe want to go over and clutch a throat.
sentences.zh: 如果你走进那个设施，跟随便一帮被关押人员谈谈，他们听到这种描述会感到震惊，或者可能会想冲过来掐住你的脖子。

sentences.en: That is not the case.
sentences.zh: 事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Phil Kerrigan has been going to the MCC for over ten years.
sentences.zh: 菲尔·克里根去MCC已经有十多年了。

sentences.en: He has kind of a designated volunteer for the MCC, and he goes and visits guys who don't have anybody else to visit them.
sentences.zh: 他是MCC的某种指定志愿者，他会去探望那些没有其他人来探望的人。

sentences.en: MCC is not a star.
sentences.zh: MCC可不是什么明星建筑。

sentences.en: It's very drab, gunmetal gray.
sentences.zh: 它非常单调，呈炮铜灰。

sentences.en: You know, the physical facility is nothing to show off.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，实体设施没什么好炫耀的。

sentences.en: The cells, the architect described them as being really nice.
sentences.zh: 那些牢房，建筑师曾将其描述为非常棒。

sentences.en: It's all this kind of hardwood, built-in furniture, for instance.
sentences.zh: 比如，全都是这种硬木的嵌入式家具。

sentences.en: Ah, they're gone.
sentences.zh: 啊，它们都没了。

sentences.en: The bunks are steel, two-tier structures, no wood.
sentences.zh: 床铺是钢铁的双层结构，没有木头。

sentences.en: And do you have sunlight coming in?
sentences.zh: 那有阳光照进来吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: The windows are generally frosted.
sentences.zh: 窗户通常都是磨砂的。

sentences.en: It doesn't allow for sunlight to come in.
sentences.zh: 不允许阳光照射进来。

sentences.en: And the place is old.
sentences.zh: 而且这个地方很旧了。

sentences.en: It's definitely undergone some changes, and none of them have been for beautification.
sentences.zh: 它确实经历了一些改造，而且没有一次是为了美化。

sentences.en: By the time Dan talked with Robert Brugman, who wrote a book about Harry Weiss, he was pretty bummed out.
sentences.zh: 当丹与写过一本关于哈里·韦斯的书的罗伯特·布鲁格曼交谈时，他感到非常沮丧。

sentences.en: There's something about this that seems kind of sad to me.
sentences.zh: 这件事本身就让我觉得有点难过。

sentences.en: You know, Harry Weiss is a brilliant architect, and this seems like it's one of his signature projects.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，哈里·韦斯是一位才华横溢的建筑师，这似乎是他的标志性项目之一。

sentences.en: His conception is not what exists today.
sentences.zh: 他当年的构想和今天存在的东西已经不一样了。

sentences.en: True.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: But, you know, there are Harry Weiss buildings going down all over the country, and that's true of almost all architects of that period.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，全国各地都有哈里·韦斯的建筑在被拆除，那个时期的几乎所有建筑师都是如此。

sentences.en: So this is a minor matter that the inside of a place that was never meant to be public has been changed.
sentences.zh: 所以，一个从未打算对公众开放的地方内部被改变了，这只是件小事。

sentences.en: You know, it is, after all, not a hotel.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，它毕竟不是一家酒店。

sentences.en: Even if the warden had let Dan into the MCC, it wasn't the MCC that he wanted to see.
sentences.zh: 即使典狱长当时让丹进了MCC，那也不是他真正想看的MCC。

sentences.en: For that matter, it wasn't the MCC that Harry Weiss wanted, either.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，那也不是哈里·韦斯想要的MCC。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Dan Weissman and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由丹·韦斯曼和我罗曼·马尔斯制作。

sentences.en: This program is made possible with support from Lunar, making a difference with creativity.
sentences.zh: 本节目由 Lunar 提供支持播出，用创意创造不同。

sentences.en: It's a project of KALW, 91.7 Local Public Radio in San Francisco, the American Institute of Architects in San Francisco, and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 这是由旧金山 KALW 91.7 地方公共广播电台、美国建筑师学会旧金山分会以及建筑与设计中心共同合作的项目。

sentences.en: To find out more and see the punch card building for yourself, go to 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 想要了解更多信息并亲自看看那座打孔卡建筑，请访问 99percentinvisible.org。
